meta.title: zeitvex · Robotics / Embedded / RL Engineer
meta.description: Personal homepage of zeitvex: robotics, embedded systems and reinforcement learning. RC_WheelLeg 16-DOF wheel-leg robot, dual-arm humanoid platform, vision gimbal and ROS 2 Sim2Real projects.

intro.title: Hi, I'm zeitvex
intro.desc:
Robotics / Embedded / RL Engineer · Class of 2027
From MCU to RL, from simulation to the real robot.

item0.title: RC_WheelLeg — Autonomous RL Wheel-Leg Robot
item0.desc: A 16-DOF serial wheel-leg robot. Led mechanical/hardware selection and the RL pipeline: 53-D observation / 16-D action with mjlab, reward and curriculum tuning, domain randomization, and PPO training under a 20 kg / 17 N·m envelope; traverses gravel, 0.20 m steps and 0.35 m walls. Completed MuJoCo Sim2Sim and ROS 2 / C++ deployment with TensorRT inference below 1 ms. ROBOCON National First Prize (top 5%), 153 GitHub stars.

item1.title: Mobile Dual-Arm Humanoid Platform
item1.desc: Built the full stack of a mobile dual-arm platform: LeRobot SAM arms + RDK X5, SolidWorks modeling and URDF export, Pico4U VR hand-controller teleoperation with IK for a 7-DOF arm, a Node.js debugging platform, ASR/TTS, environmental sensors and a millimeter-wave radar.

item2.title: Mobile Vision Tracking & Gimbal Stabilization
item2.desc: YOLOv5 + MaixCAM edge deployment with a frame-skipping detection, binarization, contour/quadrilateral fitting and perspective-transform pipeline; dual-axis gimbal scan, target confirmation, PD tracking and re-acquisition; custom 9-byte UART protocol; IMU/encoder and yaw feed-forward compensation. NUEDC National First Prize (top 2%).

item3.title: Unitree GO2 × Isaac Sim Embodied Tasks
item3.desc: Unitree GO2 tasks in Isaac Sim 4.2 + ROS 2: IMU-based line following, PPO stair-climbing policy tuning, and integration of PaddleOCR, LLM and vision models for text extraction, route planning and object recognition; deployed on GO2 EDU / Orin NX. China Software Cup National Third Prize.

item4.title: 12-DOF Serial-Bus-Servo Quadruped
item4.desc: Huawei ICT competition project: object detection trained and deployed with Ascend CANN / ModelArts, a 12-DOF serial-bus-servo quadruped with position-controlled gaits, and an inspection platform on Huawei Cloud OBS + 1Panel. Huawei ICT Provincial First Prize.

item5.title: LeRobot SO-ARM100 Replica
item5.desc: Replicated the LeRobot SO-ARM100 arm, including assembly, calibration and debugging; deployed quantized YOLO models on RDK X5 with a Docker-based graphical toolchain for pick-and-place tasks.

item6.title: Smart Logistics Vehicle
item6.desc: Engineering training competition vehicle: SO-ARM100 + RDK X5 host, ESP32-S3 + PlatformIO controller, 42 closed-loop steppers and mecanum kinematics, with serial communication for grasping and transport. Provincial Second Prize.

item7.title: RAICOM Smart Orchard Robot
item7.desc: Orchard robot with YOLOv5 fruit detection, STM32 line tracking, and a 3D-printed servo/ESP32 fruit-collection mechanism. RAICOM National Second Prize.

item8.title: Algorithm Elite Crossfire Robot
item8.desc: ROS + RPLIDAR A1 navigation for the Algorithm Elite competition: SLAM mapping, costmap inflation tuning and pan-tilt coordination. Global Campus AI Algorithm Elite Competition National Second Prize.

item9.title: NUEDC Autonomous Car
item9.desc: MSPM0G3507 autonomous car with encoder closed-loop motor control, IMU fusion and line tracking for path following and target recognition. NUEDC Provincial First Prize.
